title: Causal Mediation Analysis for Interpreting Neural NLP: The Case of Gender Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Causal mediation analysis applying targeted interventions (e.g., swapping gendered words or pronouns) on model inputs and internal mediators (neurons and attention heads) to measure changes in relative probabilities of stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical continuations on datasets like Winobias, Winogender, and a custom Professions dataset.
